findings.message: BUG-0130 misstates the cause. No code anywhere in packages/codictator/src fills {path} or {line} in pack.json remediation templates, so the unfilled placeholders are a general defect and not specific to docs guards or outside-root writes. Split the row into two defects or reword the cause. The path should also read features/packs/enforcers/docs-live.ts.
